detected_fault: Random game crashes and BSOD (Blue Screen of Death)
suggested_solution: Clean the laptop's exterior and interior, including the CPU and GPU fans to ensure proper airflow and heat dissipation.
Apply new thermal paste to the CPU and GPU to improve heat transfer efficiency.
Update the BIOS to the latest version to ensure all components are running with the latest firmware.
Run a thorough system diagnostic test to identify any hardware issues or software conflicts.
